recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
flutter_version=$(grep 'flutter-version:' .github/workflows/build-apk.yml | awk -F"'" '{print $2; exit }')
git clone -b $flutter_version https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release
mv build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
